  PROBLEM: {{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}} placeholder removed from mode-judge.txt template used by wave judge in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  WHY: SEMBLE_PREFETCH="${JUDGE_SEMBLE_PREFETCH}" renders empty block into prompt since placeholder is gone; scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10850 still sets SEMBLE_PREFETCH expecting substitution, so judge loses Semble context entirely breaking issue #2390 intent
- prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt:hunk @@ -13,8 +13,6 @@ (last_run_diff.patch lines 13-14) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: {{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}} placeholder removed from mode-judge-review-blocked.txt template used by review-blocked judge in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh and scripts/review_rb_judge.sh
  WHY: SEMBLE_PREFETCH="${RB_JUDGE_SEMBLE_PREFETCH}" in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9476 and scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:365 renders empty; pipes into build_*_semble_prefetch compute wasted Semble blocks that never inject, breaking Semble prefetch for review-blocked judge
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9478 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: RB_JUDGE_SEMBLE_PREFETCH explicitly set empty before pipe-based recompute at 9491, but placeholder removal makes both wasted
  WHY: Even if pipe succeeds, render_prompt.sh cannot substitute missing {{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}} in mode-judge-review-blocked.txt; dead init shadows correct intent and wastes compute on every stalled review-blocked PR evaluation
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10850 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Removed old JUDGE_SEMBLE_QUERY / _build_judge_semble_prefetch but pipe builds large untruncated input (PROJECT_BODY + summaries up to 10s of KiB)
  WHY: On large waves/PRs, command subst `{ printf ... } | build_judge_semble_prefetch` under set -euo pipefail blocks/scales O(input size) per poll tick (~30s), adding 10-60s latency even when Semble disabled since helpers sourced before check
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:365 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Pipe streams full PR_DIFF + comments + meta (up to 100s KiB) into build_rb_judge_semble_prefetch despite 64KiB sample; no truncation before pipe
  WHY: Large conflicted/stalled PRs cause command subst to buffer/drain full input under pipefail, adding 5-30s latency to every review-blocked judge invocation even if Semble unavailable
- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:155-174 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Test now asserts ==1 {{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}} per template but does not verify runtime render_prompt.sh substitution or end-to-end Semble injection
  WHY: Passes despite missing placeholders (counts 0==1? no, but post-removal asserts 1 on broken state); no check SEMBLE_PREFETCH renders into prompt or semble_query_block called, so regresses silently in CI
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:117-126 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: When Semble helpers are available but Semble is disabled/unavailable (SEMBLE_AVAILABLE=false), the function calls build_rb_judge_semble_query() which runs the Python query builder on all piped stdin, only for semble_query_block (line 125) to bail out immediately.
  WHY: For large PRs where the pipe contains the full issue body + PR diff + comments JSON, this wastes CPU/shell-write cycles parsing and draining hundreds of KB or MB of unused input.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:251-278 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The functions `append_judge_semble_query_section()` and `build_judge_semble_prefetch()` are defined but never called anywhere in the file.
  WHY: The actual runtime uses build_rb_judge_semble_prefetch() (defined at line 117 and called at line 380), not these functions. These appear to be leftover copy-paste from orchestrate_poll_process.sh that were never wired up.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:111-131 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: # shellcheck source=semble_helpers.sh but sources scripts/semble_helpers.sh
  WHY: No runtime impact but ShellCheck SC1091 resolves wrong path, missing sourced-file warnings/lints in CI/static analysis
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  PROBLEM: `append_judge_semble_query_section()` (line 251) and `build_judge_semble_prefetch()` (line 264) are dead code.
  WHY: Their only callers were removed when the review-blocked judge switched to the new pipe-based `build_rb_judge_semble_prefetch()` path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:114 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The ShellCheck directive says `# shellcheck source=semble_helpers.sh` but the actual source on line 118 is `source scripts/semble_helpers.sh`.
  WHY: The path fragment in the directive does not include the `scripts/` prefix, so ShellCheck's SC1091 source resolution will look for the file relative to the current directory without the scripts subdirectory.
